designations.weapon: SA80 Individual Weapon (Royal Small Arms Factory Enfield)
designations.note: Taji service inquiry list of SA80 reference names includes 'Rifle 5.56mm L85A1 (SA80)'. Original 1985 IW, superseded by the L85A2. No twist stated for the A1 designation.

Army: 'SA80 A2 comprises the Individual Weapon (IW) and the Light Support Weapon (LSW) ... Made by Heckler and Koch, they fire NATO standard 5.56 x 45mm ammunition.' The MOD cadet manual for the L98A2 (an L85A2 variant) states the SA80 twist: 6 grooves, pitch 180 mm, 1 turn right hand. Twist is for the weapon, not stated against the L85A2 designation.
Dstl: 'SA-80 L85A2 versus the L85A3 rifle'. The gov.uk L403A1 release calls the L85A3 'the current in-service' rifle. No twist stated for the A3.
Altair (defence publication): '5,56-mm subkarabinkow L22A2'. MOD THPS lists '5.56mm Carbine L22A1'. No twist stated for the carbine.
Army: 'SA80 A2 comprises the Individual Weapon (IW) and the Light Support Weapon (LSW).' The L86 is the LSW; A1 is the original 1985 variant. No designation-specific A1 twist located.
RAF: 'The L86A2 is known as the Light Support Weapon (LSW).' MOD FOI2019/08028 also states 'The L86A2 (Light Support Weapon)'. No twist stated for the LSW.
MOD cadet manual: the L98A2 is the cadet version of the L85A2, 6 grooves, pitch 180 mm, 1 turn right hand. Taji list: 'Rifle 5.56mm L98A2 (SA80)'.

UK Historic Arms Resource Centre: 'The Accuracy International AW Sniper Rifle - the L96A1 in British Service'. Taji list: 'Rifle 7.62mm L96A1 (Sniper)'. The PM was the first AI variant in UK service. No twist located for the PM.

Not mapped. No authoritative source located that states an L96A2 designation; the L96 family is documented as the L96A1 (AI PM). The source given documents the L96 family and does not list an A2. Do not treat as resolved.

Military Factory: 'The first L115 models to reach the British military were designated as the L115A1' and 'the newer L115 makes use of a heavier 8.59mm caliber cartridge'. Taji list: 'L115A1 SNIPER RIFLE'. AI AWM product page: the .338 Lapua Magnum AWM uses a '1 in 11 twist' barrel = 279.4 mm. Twist is for the AWM weapon.

The L115A2 designation was not stated in any authoritative source located; the L115 series is the AI AWM in .338 Lapua Magnum (A1 = fixed stock, A2 = folding stock variant). Mapped by family only. AI AWM .338 twist 1 in 11 = 279.4 mm.
Army: 'Manufactured by Accuracy International, the L115A3 long range rifle fires an 8.59mm bullet'. Taji list: 'L115A3 Sniper Rifle'. AI AWM .338 uses a 1 in 11 twist = 279.4 mm.
MOD THPS: '7.62mm Counter Terrorism Sniper Rifle L118A1'. AI AW Series brochure: the standard .308 AW barrel is listed as 1 in 12 = 304.8 mm.

designations.weapon: Accuracy International AW (Arctic Warfare) 7.62, folding stock
designations.note: Forgotten Weapons: 'the weapon was formally classified as the L118A1 (fixed stock) and L118A2 (folding stock)'. AI AW brochure: .308 AW barrel 1 in 12 = 304.8 mm.
gov.uk: 'Their main weapon is the 5.56mm C8 Colt Diemaco (L119A1), made in Canada.' MOD THPS lists '5.56mm Diemarco C8 Standard (16") L119A1'. C8 barrel 1 turn in 178 mm (7 in) = 177.8 mm.
Taji list: 'C8 Carbine, Rifle 5.56mm Assault L119A2'. The C8 family barrel twist is 1 turn in 178 mm (7 in) = 177.8 mm.

Army: the L129A1 sharpshooter rifle 'fires a 7.62mm round'. LMT contract page: 'The LMT L129A1 - contracted by United Kingdom Ministry of Defence. Chambered in 7.62mm x 51mm ... LMT patented monolithic Modular Weapon System, MWS'. LMT Reference Rifle (LM308SSR) spec: 'Rifling Twist Rate 1:11.25"' = 285.75 mm.

Small Arms Defense Journal (defence publication): the L129A2 is the LMT midlife upgrade of the L129A1 'in 6.5 Creedmoor', and 'The barrel twist is 1:8-inch RH' = 203.2 mm. Chambering changed from 7.62x51mm NATO to 6.5mm Creedmoor.

Royal Navy: 'The Knight's Stoner 1 (KS-1) rifle (designated L403A1)'. gov.uk: 'The Alternative Individual Weapon (AIW) system - known as the L403A1 ... The rifle is manufactured by Knights Armament Corporation (US)'. KAC KS-1 page: '1 in 7" (17.8 cm) Twist' = 177.8 mm.
Taji list: 'L81A2 Cadet Tgt Rifle'. UK Historic Arms Resource Centre: the L81A2 is a shortened Parker-Hale M82 7.62mm target rifle. No twist stated.

The L7A1 is the original variant of the FN MAG general purpose machine gun; the Army page documents the in-service L7A2 as '7.62mm x 51mm belt-fed general purpose machine gun'. No twist stated in the sources examined.

designations.weapon: FN MAG (GPMG), UK build by Manroy Engineering
designations.note: Army: 'The L7A2 General Purpose Machine Gun (GPMG) is a 7.62mm x 51mm belt-fed general purpose machine gun ... Manufacturer: Manroy Engineering (UK)'. RAF: 'General Purpose Machine Gun (L7A2)'. No twist stated in the sources examined.

Elite UK Forces: 'The (L110A1 & L110A2) Light Machine Gun (LMG) is the MoD designation for the Minimi PARA'. The Minimi/M249 barrel twist is '1 turn in 7 inches' = 177.8 mm (US Army TM 9-1005-201-10). Twist is for the Minimi weapon.
MOD DESA factsheet: 'The L110 A2 Light Machine Gun (LMG) is the UK MOD designation for the FN Herstal MINIMI PARA.' Minimi/M249 twist '1 turn in 7 inches' = 177.8 mm (US Army TM 9-1005-201-10).
Not mapped. MOD FOI2019/08028 (Defence Equipment and Support, 22 July 2019): 'The MOD has never procured any weapon with the designation L110A3.' There is no such UK designation.
Imperial War Museums collection: 'Sling, L108A1 5.56mm Minimi LMG'. Minimi/M249 twist '1 turn in 7 inches' = 177.8 mm (US Army TM 9-1005-201-10).

Army: 'The powerful L111A1 12.7mm (.50) Heavy Machine Gun (HMG) is an updated version of the Browning M2 Fifty-cal'. RAF: 'Heavy Machine Gun (L111A1)'. US Army TM 9-1005-213-10 tabulated data: 'one turn in 15 in' = 381.0 mm, 8 lands and grooves.

designations.weapon: FN FAL, UK inch pattern Self-Loading Rifle (SLR)
designations.note: FN FAL user's manual: 4 grooves, right hand, pitch 1 in 305 mm (11.9 in, 304.8 mm). The L1A1 is the UK inch-pattern FN FAL.
MOD DESA factsheet: 'BENELLI L128A1 ... The L128A1 is a combat shotgun operating on an ARGO (Auto Regulating Gas Operated) twin operating system'. 12 bore smoothbore, so no rifling twist.
Royal Armouries collection: 'Centrefire pump-action military shotgun - Remington Wingmaster Model 870 - L74A1'. MOD THPS lists '12 Bore Shotgun L74A2'. 12 bore smoothbore, so no rifling twist.
MOD THPS: '9mm Glock 17 L131A1'. Taji list: 'L131A1 Designation for Glock 17 GSP'. GLOCK Armorer's Manual: 9mm barrel '250mm' / '9.84 in' right hand twist.
MOD THPS: '9mm Glock 19 L137A1'. GLOCK Armorer's Manual: 9mm barrels use a 250 mm (9.84 in) right hand twist.
Taji list: '9mm Sig Sauer L105A1'. SIG Sauer P226 manual technical data: 'Rifling lead 250 mm' for 9mm.
RAF: 'Glock - L131A1 and Sig Sauer L105A2'. MOD Army Dress Committee minutes: 'Pistol Automatic L105A2 (Sig Sauer)'. Taji list: 'L105A2 SIG 226A2'. SIG P226 manual: rifling lead 250 mm.
MOD DIN Digest September 2013: 'Service Date of L107A1 P228 Tri Service'. No twist stated for the P228 in the sources examined.
gov.uk: 'The Glock 17 Gen4 pistol is not only much lighter than the Browning L9A1'. Taji list: 'Pistol Automatic 9mm L9A1' and 'L9A1 Browning'. No maker twist source located.

Altair (defence publication): 'L80A1 (MP5K)'. MOD THPS lists '9mm Heckler & Koch MP5K' in UK service. HK MP5 manual: '1 turn in 9.86"' = 250.4 mm right hand twist. The UK government source confirms the MP5K but not the L-number.
Not mapped. The defence publication lists L80A1 (MP5K) but no L80A2; no authoritative source located for an L80A2 designation. Do not treat as resolved.

Altair (defence publication): 'L91A1 (MP5SD3)'. MOD THPS lists '9mm Heckler & Koch MP5SD'. HK MP5 manual: 1 turn in 9.86" = 250.4 mm right hand twist. The UK government source confirms the MP5SD but not the L-number. Note: one secondary site gives L91A1 as MP5A3; the defence publication is preferred.

Altair (defence publication): 'L92A1 (MP5A3)'. MOD THPS lists '9mm Heckler & Koch MP5A3'. HK MP5 manual: 1 turn in 9.86" = 250.4 mm right hand twist. The UK government source confirms the MP5A3 but not the L-number.

Altair (defence publication): '37-mm granatnikow L104A1 (wprowadzona do brytyjskiego wojska w 2001 odmiana HK69A1)'. MOD THPS lists '37mm Riot/L104A2'. Smoothbore less-lethal launcher, no rifling twist. Not an MP5 variant.
